note: Category set after product-owner decisions of 24 October 2026. IDs approved; labels shortened to fit a 3-column tile at 320 px; Bills merged into Home; Unknown removed and replaced by Other. Entries marked provisional (and the order) still need confirmation — see src/data/README.md.
orderBasis: Largest expected spend first, ranked by share of urban household spending in MoSPI's Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2023-24. Categories with no matching survey line follow; Other is always last. Mapping in src/data/README.md.

categories.label: Shop
categories.description: Clothing, footwear, electronics, appliances, household items and other purchases.

categories.label: Home
categories.description: Rent, maintenance and repairs, plus household bills: electricity, gas, water, phone, internet and subscriptions.

categories.label: Transit
categories.description: Day-to-day travel: fuel, cabs, autos, parking, public transport.

categories.label: Health
categories.description: Doctors, medicines, tests, hospital bills, health insurance.

categories.label: Travel
categories.description: Trips away from home: flights, trains, hotels, holiday spending.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Anything that doesn't fit the categories above, or when the user isn't sure. Always last; combines freely with other categories.
